ns2:course.label: Internship Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar based on internship experience. Offered for College of Media students who complete an approved professional, industry related internship. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 2 undergraduate hours or 2 graduate hours. May be repeated in subsequent terms to a maximum of 3 undergraduate hours or 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
